scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHP test suite (inside the PHP test container; from the Mac use scripts/test-tiers.sh).
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the PHP test suite with Xdebug coverage into coverage/clover.xml and coverage/html/.
scripts-descriptions.coverage:snapshot: Write docs/coverage/<date>.md from the PHP and JS coverage reports. Args: <YYYY-MM-DD> <commit-sha>.
